question: Which of the following inflammatory mediators exerts a synergistic effect with prostglandin E2 (PGE2) in the increase of vascular permeability ?:
analysis: Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) is known to play a role in increasing vascular permeability, often in conjunction with other inflammatory mediators. Among the options provided, leukotrienes, particularly Leukotriene B4 (LTB4), are known to have a role in inflammation and can work synergistically with prostaglandins to enhance vascular permeability. LTB4 is a potent chemotactic agent and can amplify the effects of other mediators like PGE2 in the inflammatory response.
